name: [NEW ISLAND!] Toy Car Tycoon
desc:
👋 Welcome to Toy Car Tycoon! 👋

In Toy Car Tycoon, you relive your childhood dream of building HUGE stunt tracks in your backyard! Start small and work your way up, unlocking different areas. Watch cars fly through the air and get launched through booster tracks!

There is so much to discover.
